This plot is rented, so I must get enough yield to pay the landlord and still feed my household. I will apply two and a half bags of NPK fertilizer because the soil here in the North Central is tired, and I will add manure that I have saved from my animals to help the crop. I am using my own seeds kept from last season since the improved ones are too expensive and hard to find, and my family will do most of the work ourselves with just a few extra hands during the busiest times.
